title: Onyx Craft Firecracker Host Agent
description: Craft Firecracker host agent, per node. Metrics: microvm/README.md. Runbooks: microvm/RUNBOOKS.md.

panels.title: Agents up
panels.description: Host agent scrape targets that answer. No data: Prometheus has no agent target.

panels.title: Agents down
panels.description: Scrape targets that do not answer. No data: Prometheus has no agent target.

targets.expr: count(up{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", job="__CRAFT_FC_HOST_AGENT_JOB__"} == 0) or (count(up{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", job="__CRAFT_FC_HOST_AGENT_JOB__"}) * 0)

panels.title: Agent pods unavailable
panels.description: Desired - available agent pods (kube-state-metrics). A node with no agent pod has no scrape target.

panels.title: VMs by node and state
panels.description: VMs in the agent table. Exited VMs are not shown.

panels.title: Create latency p50 / p95 (created)
panels.description: Create calls that started a new VM (snapshot restore, guest key install).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (node, le) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_create_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", result="created"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (node, le) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_create_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", result="created"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Create results
panels.description: created: new VM. existing: repeat call for a VM that runs. refused: stopped before admission passed. failed: the start failed after admission.

panels.title: Admission refusals and failures by reason
panels.description: reason is the ErrorReason name. NODE_DRAINING is normal during a drain.

targets.expr: sum by (node, result, reason) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_admissions_total{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", result!="admitted"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Guest memory allocated vs node memory
panels.description: Allocated = guest memory of VMs that are not exited. In use = MemTotal - MemAvailable. When in use stays below allocated, the balloon (free page reporting) gives guest memory back to the node. The agent has no direct balloon metric.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_node_memory_total_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) - sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_node_memory_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Node memory available
panels.description: MemAvailable / MemTotal. Admission needs MemAvailable >= starting VMs + the new VM + --min-free-mem-mib. Alert: CraftFcNodeMemoryLow.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_node_memory_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_node_memory_total_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Guest memory allocated / node memory
panels.description: Guest memory promised to VMs as a share of node memory. Over 100% means overcommit that the balloon makes possible.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_vm_memory_allocated_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"}) / sum by (node) (craft_fc_host_agent_node_memory_total_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Data disk free
panels.description: Free space on the agent data disk. Create needs --min-free-disk-gib; captures reserve --capture-max-bytes.

panels.title: Node stats read errors
panels.description: 1 = the last scrape could not read node memory or disk. Create then refuses with CAPACITY_MEMORY or CAPACITY_DISK.

panels.title: Relay connections by result
panels.description: accepted, over_cap (VM over --relay-max-conns, closed at once), upstream_failed (an accepted connection that sandbox-proxy did not answer). Alert: CraftFcRelayErrors.

panels.title: Relay error ratio
panels.description: Failed connections / all VM connections. A connection counts once as accepted or over_cap; an accepted one can also count as upstream_failed.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_relay_connections_total{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", result=~"over_cap|upstream_failed"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_relay_connections_total{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", result=~"accepted|over_cap"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Open relay connections and Dial streams
Capture / upload / restore duration p95
panels.description: rpc_duration_seconds uses the default buckets (up to 10 s), so longer transfers show as 10 s or more.

panels.title: Capture / upload / restore calls by code
panels.description: Alert: CraftFcSessionTransferFailures (codes other than OK and Canceled).

panels.title: BuildTemplate calls by code
panels.description: Only BuildTemplate API calls. The start-up build has no metric: read the agent log ("template ready" or "template build at start-up failed").

panels.title: Duration p95 by method
panels.description: Dial is left out: it counts the whole stream.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, le) (rate(craft_fc_host_agent_rpc_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", method!="Dial"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Guest daemon pass-through errors by method and code
Guest log bytes shipped and dropped
Sandbox ready p95 by outcome
panels.description: Time a user waits for a ready sandbox, from the api_server. Not filtered by node.
